MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The 32GB microSD card feels like a natural spare because I have repeatedly bought memory cards and adapters for my devices.",
    "The USB hub and extension cables would help me connect and position my card reader and other accessories, fitting my habit of buying practical additions to equipment I already use."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo devices and Fire TV Stick introduce uses I have not expressed a current need for; owning a TV or Fire tablet does not mean I want voice control or a different TV setup.",
    "The security bundle does not serve the same purpose as my photography tripods and lens cap, while six short Ethernet cables do not match the connections or reach I currently need.",
    "The larger Fire tablet interests me, but that interest is not enough to replace my working Fire 7 now; the earbuds likewise lack a clear connection to a current need."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My ownership of Amazon devices seems to have been taken as interest in more Amazon devices, even when they serve different purposes.",
    "Buying cameras accessories and cables seems to have been treated as interest in any camera product or cable, without enough attention to what I use them for."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of memory cards, adapters, a card reader, and storage cases show an ongoing need to store, transfer, and organize files.",
    "My accessory purchases depend on practical details such as connector type, compatibility, cable length, and use with existing equipment.",
    "I often add useful accessories to devices I already own, so ownership alone is not a reason for me to buy a replacement or start a new setup."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my need for storage and USB accessories but stretched device ownership into interest in unrelated electronics and upgrades."
}
